# Isaiah Chapter 47 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 15 verses]*

*Virgin daughter Babylon humbled; loss of children; astrologers cannot save; no deliverer*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** You felt secure in your wickedness; you said, No one sees me. This chapter virgin daughter babylon humbled.

*-- LOGOS*
